_provenance.seats: Shape per docs/game-design.md §'The scenario system' — a scenario names one world, one ruleset, and a control assignment per nation. Personality values are docs/game-design.md §AI's designed 0-1 parameters; there is no original analogue, since docs/design-audit.md §1 records that the original's TPickLeaders screen assigns a nation to a human or the computer and a leader name only, with no per-nation AI tuning at all.
_provenance.turnLimit: designed: a short limit so an all-AI soak over this scenario terminates. Searched docs/reports/ for a turn limit in the original and found only the year-250 comparison on the game-over screen (decompiled-diplomacy-peace-terms-and-instant-battles.md), which is a year test rather than a turn count, so there is no original turn limit to transcribe.
_provenance.randomSeed: A fixed seed so every test run over this scenario is reproducible, per docs/game-design.md principle 4. The value itself carries no meaning.
